subject: S22 perf: options 4 (c8b3142, auth - please review as auth) and 3 (984a9d0) landed; initial JS 278 KB, ~243 after seg17's PathwayPage lazy
body: Option 4: supabase-js off the first load (-54 KB). session.test.ts covers fresh start without the client, expired refresh, expiry margin, offline expired, offline start without the chunk, revoked refresh, background sign-out, cross-tab sign-out/refresh before the client loads, client events incl. callback sign-in, refresh, local/global sign-out. e2e green on WebKit iPad + Chromium: auth, auth-once (real magic link, reload, sign out, sign out everywhere), offline learn/cards/notes, CSP, console guard. Live-auth e2e needs the Space on this build: will run in deploy after promotion. Option 3: admin/review copy with the admin chunks (-13 KB), guarded by adminCopySplit.test.ts. Pre-existing local failures (same on a clean build): pathway/library specs (pathway renders Today onboarding), cards 322 + notes 208 (WebKit SW routing / Ask button), admin authoring storage 503 on WebKit. seg17: PathwayPage lazyPage is the last big piece; then I do option 2 (SDK split) and flip PERF_GATE=enforce.
